name: Find Something on Screen
description: Help the user find a button, icon, or menu item by taking a screenshot of their screen and highlighting where it is
prompt: The user wants you to look at their screen or can't find something. You MUST call take_screenshot immediately to actually capture and analyze their screen. Do NOT describe what you think is there — use the tool to see it for real. After analyzing the screenshot, describe what you see and point out the relevant element. If the screenshot tool fails (no relay or screen share), explain that you need them to either click 'Share Screen' or connect their computer first.
